Type: implementation task (sub-task of F02.3)
Work key: F02.3.4
Parent: F02.3 (bd-01M4W5P591G5D5048MSJ46BN27)
Plan: docs/decisions/001-institutional-organization.md (transition table, public API contract), ADR 003 (recovery)

Scope: one command that appoints the receiving steward and ends the giving steward atomically, with expected generations, so a transfer can never leave zero or duplicate stewardship and a retry cannot transfer twice.
Acceptance: concurrent transfers resolve to one; last-steward protection holds; audit names both appointments.
set.title: F02.3.4: Atomic dataset stewardship transfer
